data.description:
## Context / Problem
The scheduled Windows sweep on main (run 44877036143, job 136763903330, at ebd2a68a451, after 2693d59a047 landed) failed 3 tests, all in `tests/unit/test_check_verify_host.py`; nothing else failed (20381 passed). This blocks charitable-tyrannical-hydra and sporting-feudalist-bluet, which need 3 consecutive green Windows sweeps.
- `test_unix_socket_probe_passes_when_bind_listen_and_connect_succeed`: `assert [] == ['bind', 'listen', 'connect', 'close', 'close']`
- `test_unix_socket_probe_reports_a_denied_bind`: `assert not True`
- `test_unix_socket_probe_passes_where_the_platform_has_no_af_unix`: `AttributeError: AF_UNIX` at `monkeypatch.delattr(mod.socket, "AF_UNIX")`

## Root cause (verified from the job log)
CPython on Windows has no `socket.AF_UNIX`. `unix_socket_probe` returns `(True, "")` before touching the socket factory when `AF_UNIX` is absent, which is its intended contract: the tests that need AF_UNIX skip there (`test_reclaim_resign.py` skips on win32, `test_network_guard_local_ipc.py` skips without `AF_UNIX`). The 3 tests assumed the host has `AF_UNIX`: the two fake-socket tests never reached the fake, and `monkeypatch.delattr` raises on a missing attribute. A product defect it is not.

## Approach
Make the 3 tests set the platform condition they test instead of inheriting it from the host, in `tests/unit/test_check_verify_host.py`:
- The two fake-socket tests set `socket.AF_UNIX` on the probe module's `socket` with `monkeypatch.setattr(mod.socket, "AF_UNIX", 1, raising=False)`, and `_FakeSocket` stops asserting the family value against the host constant.
- The no-AF_UNIX test uses `monkeypatch.delattr(mod.socket, "AF_UNIX", raising=False)`.
No skip is added: all 3 tests run on every platform, and the probe is unchanged.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/test_check_verify_host.py`

## Testing
- macOS: the module passes.
- Windows: a `gh workflow run 294845723 --ref <temp branch>` dispatch of the Windows sweep on the change shows the 3 tests passing, recorded here; the temp branch is deleted afterwards.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The 3 tests pass on macOS and in a Windows sweep dispatched on the change, with the run recorded here.
- [ ] No test in the module is skipped on any platform.
- [ ] `make verify` passes and Gerrit gives Verified +1.
data.title: Windows sweep: verify-host probe tests assume the host has socket.AF_UNIX
